passages.sermon:
This is a psalm.
Asaph wrote this psalm.

passages.text: God presides in the divine assembly; He renders judgment among the gods: “How long will you judge unjustly and show partiality to the wicked? Selah Defend the cause of the weak and fatherless; uphold the rights of the afflicted and oppressed.
passages.sermon:
This is a psalm of Asaph.
God stands in the assembly of the mighty.
God judges among the gods.
God asks, “How long will you judge unjustly?
How long will you show favor to the wicked?”
Defend the weak.
Defend the fatherless.
Uphold the rights of the afflicted.
Uphold the rights of the oppressed.
passages.original: מִזְמ֗וֹר לְאָ֫סָ֥ף אֱ‍ֽלֹהִ֗ים נִצָּ֥ב בַּעֲדַת־ אֵ֑ל בְּקֶ֖רֶב אֱלֹהִ֣ים יִשְׁפֹּֽט׃ עַד־ מָתַ֥י תִּשְׁפְּטוּ־ עָ֑וֶל וּפְנֵ֥י רְ֝שָׁעִ֗ים תִּשְׂאוּ־ סֶֽלָה׃ שִׁפְטוּ־ דַ֥ל וְיָת֑וֹם עָנִ֖י וָרָ֣שׁ הַצְדִּֽיקוּ׃

passages.text: Rescue the weak and needy; save them from the hand of the wicked.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to the judges in the assembly.
He commands them.
Rescue the weak.
Rescue the needy.
Save them from the hand of the wicked.
passages.original: פַּלְּטוּ־ דַ֥ל וְאֶבְי֑וֹן מִיַּ֖ד רְשָׁעִ֣ים הַצִּֽילוּ׃

passages.text: They do not know or understand; they wander in the darkness; all the foundations of the earth are shaken.
passages.sermon:
Some people do not know.
They do not understand.
They walk in darkness.
All the foundations of the earth shake.
passages.original: לֹ֤א יָֽדְע֨וּ׀ וְלֹ֥א יָבִ֗ינוּ בַּחֲשֵׁכָ֥ה יִתְהַלָּ֑כוּ יִ֝מּ֗וֹטוּ כָּל־ מ֥וֹסְדֵי אָֽרֶץ׃

passages.text: I have said, ‘You are gods; you are all sons of the Most High.’
passages.sermon:
Asaph wrote this psalm as a song.
God speaks to the judges and rulers.
God says, “You are gods.”
God says, “You are all sons of the Most High.”
passages.original: אֲ‍ֽנִי־ אָ֭מַרְתִּי אֱלֹהִ֣ים אַתֶּ֑ם וּבְנֵ֖י עֶלְי֣וֹן כֻּלְּכֶֽם׃

passages.text: But like mortals you will die, and like rulers you will fall.”
passages.sermon:
You are all sons of the Most High.
You are gods.
But you will die like mortals.
You will fall like rulers.
passages.original: אָ֭כֵן כְּאָדָ֣ם תְּמוּת֑וּן וּכְאַחַ֖ד הַשָּׂרִ֣ים תִּפֹּֽלוּ׃

passages.text: Arise, O God, judge the earth, for all the nations are Your inheritance.
passages.sermon:
God is the Most High.
God owns all nations.
God, stand up.
God, judge the earth.
All nations belong to You.
passages.original: קוּמָ֣ה אֱ֭לֹהִים שָׁפְטָ֣ה הָאָ֑רֶץ כִּֽי־ אַתָּ֥ה תִ֝נְחַ֗ל בְּכָל־ הַגּוֹיִֽם׃
